rules.why: A tab group for panels is named.
A panel tab is <button type="button" role="tab"> with aria-selected and aria-controls to its panel.
Only the selected tab sits in the Tab order.
The others are reached with the arrows.
The panel points back to its tab.
A navigation tab is a link, never role="tab".
Each tab has a visible label.
A disabled tab leaves the group.

manual.why: Tab and panel are linked by id: no id repeats on the page.
From 2 to 6 tabs in a group (a Sidebar list owns its own count).
Two levels at most: the second lives in the panel, never inside the group; Line outside, Square inside.
aria-controls points to a role="tabpanel" whose aria-labelledby is that same tab.
The panel starts with a heading equal to the tab's label - it is what pays for the tonal selection.
Exactly one selected tab; at most one link with aria-current.
A group is role="tablist" or lives in a named <nav> - one of the two.
A .al-tab lives inside a .al-tabs: the type belongs to the group.
An aria-hidden sample is also inert, or the keyboard reaches a tab the screen reader cannot see.
